description: Search normalized public license records from promoted official sources. Arizona ADHS remains a partial provider-name search; California DCC remains a one-page partial search with unverified total/paging; New York OCM (jskf-tt3q) is an official statewide Socrata dataset whose exact filtered count, schema evidence, source refresh time and resumable paging are returned on every call — OCM rows are explicitly classified as active/expired/surrendered/cancelled/revoked-if-observed/pending/proximity-protection/under-review rather than treating every row as an active license; Oregon OLCC (or_olcc_cannabis_licenses) and Connecticut establishments (ct_cannabis_establishments) are official Socrata registers with exact counts. fedwatch_sources carries a licenses entry for all 50 states + DC with each program's status. Unnecessary personal contact fields are not fetched.

county.description: NY OCM only: exact county, e.g. 'Kings'

keyword.description: Facility/business/license/application fragment; at least 2 characters for ADHS, optional for the Socrata/API sources

limit.description: Maximum returned rows. Tier-capped for search; NY OCM supports explicit resume metadata when the exact filtered set is larger.

page_size.description: NY OCM only: bounded page size, 1-1000 (default 500)

record_class.description: NY OCM only: active_license | expired_license | surrendered_license | cancelled_license | revoked_license | pending_application | proximity_protection | license_under_review | inactive_license

source_id.description: Source id: azdhs_marijuana_facilities (default), ca_dcc_cannabis_licenses, ny_ocm_cannabis_licenses, or_olcc_cannabis_licenses, ct_cannabis_establishments

start_offset.description: NY OCM only: row offset for an explicit resume. Any non-zero start is deliberately partial.

status.description: CA/NY: exact upstream status or status code, e.g. 'Active' or 'LICACT'; OR/CT: exact license status

name: licenses_search
